title: Let a Papyrus site's owners and admins change memberships and invite people
description:
Feature: Membership changes from a Papyrus site
  Scenario: An admin changes a member's role
    Given an account entitled to papyrus-<site> and an enrolled admin or owner
    When the site server calls POST /v1/accounts/{id}/memberships as the site role with that person's token and {personId, role, status}
    Then central applies it with revision compare-and-set, refuses non-admins, and never removes the last owner

  Scenario: Invite someone who has never signed in
    Given the invite-by-email flow of kanbus-59284c
    When an admin invites an address
    Then the invited person becomes a member only after they sign in and accept, and email never becomes an identity key

Change: grant papyrus-<site> editor registrations the members:write capability and the POST/v1/accounts/*/memberships route. Today no registered caller may call it (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md route table). Role-by-Person-ID changes can ship first; invitations depend on kanbus-59284c and kanbus-b2ddb4. This changes the API resource policy and the registered capabilities, so it needs Ryan's approval.
